_meta.definition: The process of managing and analyzing demographic data related to population growth, infant mortality, and other relevant statistics for countries.

population._description: Tracks demographic data for various countries, including population size and growth rate, as well as infant mortality rates.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries in the population table.

columns.name: Population_Growth
columns.description: Stores annual population growth rates as positive (growth) or negative (decline) floating point numbers.

columns.name: Infant_Mortality
columns.description: Stores infant mortality rates per 1000 live births.
